name: NewPipe
title: NewPipe: free YouTube Premium alternative
caption:
YouTube Premium charges $15.99/month to remove ads and play in the background. NewPipe does both for free 📺

✅ Plays YouTube without ads, no Google account needed
✅ Listen in the background with the screen off, audio only to save data
✅ Floating popup player so you can watch while using other apps
✅ Download videos or just the audio, and subscribe to channels without signing in

💻 Android
ℹ️ Android only, still in beta, and not on Google Play: install it from F-Droid or the APK on GitHub

Comment "TUBE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #youtube #android #youtubepremium #freeapps #techtips

beats.say: There's a free app that makes YouTube Premium pointless, and nobody talks about it.
Wait, YouTube with no ads, for free?
YouTube Premium is sixteen dollars a month. NewPipe costs nothing.
Lock your Android phone, and the audio keeps playing in the background.
Or float the video in a little popup over your other apps.
Download videos and subscribe to channels, with no Google account.
It's YouTube Premium, minus the bill, forever.
